description.zh: 光标到达屏幕外边时从对边进入（多显示器边缘拓扑，支持仅纵向/仅横向与按住 Ctrl/Shift 激活）；cursorwrap 关键字查看状态与开关
description.en: The cursor re-enters from the opposite edge when it reaches an outer edge (multi-monitor edge topology; vertical/horizontal-only modes and Ctrl/Shift activation); the cursorwrap keyword shows status and toggles it

hint.zh: 留空看状态；不需要输入文字
hint.en: empty shows status; no text needed

ai.description: Show the cursor-wrap status: whether wrapping is enabled, the wrap mode, the activation mode, monitor count and outer-edge count. Read-only; nothing changes until an action runs.

hint.zh: both：四个方向；vertical：仅上/下；horizontal：仅左/右
hint.en: both: all four; vertical: top/bottom only; horizontal: left/right only

hint.zh: always 立即生效；ctrl / shift 需按住该键才回绕（Ctrl 单独滚轮留给任务栏音量插件，本插件只看移动）
hint.en: always wraps immediately; ctrl / shift wrap only while the key is held (plain Ctrl stays with the taskbar volume plugin — this plugin only watches movement)

hint.zh: 按住左键拖动窗口或选区时禁用，防止把窗口甩到对角
hint.en: disables wrapping while the left button is held, so dragged windows stay put

hint.zh: 只接一块屏时也回绕到本屏对边（PowerToys 默认行为）；不想这样可关掉
hint.en: on one display the cursor still wraps to the same display's opposite edge (PowerToys default); turn off to disable that

hint.zh: 1–20，默认 1；离外边多近才算到了边上
hint.en: 1–20, default 1; how close to an outer edge counts as being on it

hint.zh: 10–200，默认 50；回绕后在这个范围内不再触发，防止来回弹
hint.en: 10–200, default 50; after a wrap, events within this range of the destination do not wrap again

hint.zh: 10–200，默认 50；两条边差多少像素以内算相邻（内边不回绕）
hint.en: 10–200, default 50; edges closer than this count as adjacent (inner edges never wrap)

hint.zh: 开启后光标必须以足够速度撞到边缘才回绕；慢慢挪到边缘（比如去点任务栏）不会触发
hint.en: when on, the cursor must hit the edge fast enough to wrap; drifting to the edge (say, toward the taskbar) does not trigger

hint.zh: 500–20000，默认 2000；按 100ms 窗口内垂直于边缘的速度判定，沿边缘平行滑动不算
hint.en: 500–20000, default 2000; judged by the speed perpendicular to the edge over a 100 ms window — sliding along the edge does not count
